podcast.body: This entry describes an alternate, and somewhat rare, recording of Joy Division's 1980 single. It was pressed on a 12-inch record that spins at 33 and a third RPM, which is noted as being a "tiny bit unusual" for a single of that format. "This is an alternate recording of Joy Division's Love will Terrorist Apart. It's a single on a 12-inch record that spins at 33 and a third, which is just a tiny bit unusual."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
